label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Sam Burns leads U.S. Open
items.text: Sam Burns leads the U.S. Open at -1 through 8 holes, tied with Patrick Reed, Ludvig Åberg, and Ben James all also at -1.

items.headline: McIlroy grabs early U.S. Open lead
items.text: Rory McIlroy birdied two of his first three holes on Thursday to seize the early lead at the fog-affected U.S. Open.

items.headline: USGA changes to Shinnecock Hills
items.text: The USGA has made course changes at Shinnecock Hills aiming to make the 2026 U.S. Open the toughest major in years due to ominous weather forecasts.
